biography: Pratik Sonawane, born in the bustling streets of Mumbai, India, discovered his passion for speed amidst the chaos of everyday life. His father, a mechanic, introduced him to the inner workings of engines at a young age. Pratik started with go-karting at a local track, quickly outshining his peers with his raw talent and fearless driving style. A pivotal moment came when, at 18, he secured a scholarship to a European racing academy after winning a national karting championship. This opportunity transformed him from a local talent into a rising star on the international stage. He now competes for VW Virtus GTS, aiming for the top step in every race, fueled by a relentless drive to prove himself against the best.
drivingStyle: Sonawane's driving style is characterized by aggressive overtaking maneuvers and late-braking techniques. He's known for pushing his car to the absolute limit, often flirting with the edge of control. Tire management isn't his forte; he prefers to extract maximum performance in short bursts, relying on his raw speed to compensate. Under pressure, Sonawane becomes even more tenacious, relishing the challenge of close wheel-to-wheel battles and rarely backing down from a fight.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision that cost Sonawane a championship victory.
Clashed frequently on track due to their similar aggressive driving styles, leading to several on-track incidents and off-track verbal sparring.
Their rivalry started in a junior series, where they consistently battled for the lead, creating a fierce competitive tension.

quirks: Always wears a traditional Indian bracelet for good luck.
Listens to Bollywood music at full volume right before every race.
Refuses to start a race if his steering wheel isn't perfectly aligned.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. You have to be willing to risk everything to win."
careerHighlight: Winning the Macau Grand Prix in 2021, a hard-fought victory against formidable competition in treacherous conditions, showcasing his exceptional skill and bravery.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the championship-deciding race in 2022, costing him the title and leaving him devastated.
